'''Destabilization''', also known as '''Destab''', was a branch of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence's]] [[Bureau of Operations/Legends|Bureau of Operations]]. Their operations were kept quiet, as details of their activities&mdash;which ranged from legitimate Intelligence operations to full scale atrocities&mdash;were enough to make most agents sick. Officially, their mandate was to unravel the fabric of society.<ref name="ISB" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a team of Destabilization Branch infiltrators traveled to the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Morjanssik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and enacted the [[Calamari Project]], a covert operation that aimed to spark a war between the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Species/Legends|species]], to prevent the two species from supplying [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. However, a group of Alliance agents tracked down and defeated the infiltrators, bringing the Calamari Project to an end.<ref name="DitU">''[[Death in the Undercity]]''</ref>

[[Secesh Trant]],<ref name="C72 Ananuru Express">{{ChallengeCite|72|Ananuru Express (article)}}</ref>  and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kerri Lessev/Legends|Kerri Lessev]] worked in the organization.<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref> The division's higher [[bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrats]] could reach the rank of [[General/Legends|General]], even remaining non-combat. The ranks distinguished the roles from the minor bureaucrats and field [[operative/Legends|operative]]s. General [[Harrid Sendo]], was a veteran [[Scandoc/Legends|scandoc]] "review specialist", a position that gave him access to his and other branches. Furthermore, he was corrupted by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], and changing [[courier/Legends|courier]]s were receiving his reports.<ref name="SotESB">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
